# Roalla Business Enablement Group
# https://www.roalla.com

> Digital Enablement partner — websites, custom apps, client portals, integrations, workflow automation, practical AI, digital events, and business workshops. Based in Burlington, ON, serving clients globally. Bilingual: English and French.
